items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: I don't know his name, that's not... Jimmy Noon, Johnny Dox.

ctx.x: He lived on Liberty and what?

And, uh, this other boy, what I'm trying to think, played clarinet. He was, uh, they got some records that, up there, uh, of him. Of this boy playing clarinet. Had a band. He had a band, too. I don't know his name, that's not... Jimmy Noon, Johnny Dox.
